name: Seth Massey
life: “I still remember being allowed one offcut from a valuable sheet.” People around the steps at Pier Beach know Seth by a small Sunday habit. Seth watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: I cut a little sample from the replacement glass. She found the window of her old flat reflected in it.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a faded indigo overshirt and a little coil of soft measuring tape. Seth has a flat bridge to the nose and a mobile brow, with a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Seth squares up pieces of paper while thinking during a conversation.
personality: Seth never tires of being shown how somebody makes a living. Seth can ask an expert question of a craftsperson and still mishandle a simple emotional cue from a friend.
agenda: To show the widow the reflection caught in the offcut.
family: Drew Ferraro is Seth’s first cousin once removed. Seth calls back when there is finally a little privacy. Drew leaves the first voice message. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *The school photograph that travels*, Drew says, “I supplied uniforms on credit until her mother's work picked up.”
connections: Malcolm Lund. A sample of new glass offers a familiar apartment reflection without pretending to be the original mirror.
